top_signals.title: OpenAI Reports New Safety Incidents, Sets Disclosure Plan
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg News AI reporter Shirin Ghaffary said that recent disclosures of AI safety incidents at OpenAI are a 'watershed moment' in the public understanding of AI risks as models get more powerful and employees issue warnings. Ghaffary said that getting AI models to align with companies intended goals is an ongoing issue and a the fact that it hasn't been solved yet amid rising AI integration is a 'big, big problem.'  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: America Is Paying a Lot for Fuel, Not Running Out of Gasoline
top_signals.summary: Gasoline is expensive. Diesel is worse. Social media is melting down and has apparently decided America is running out of fuel. U.S. gasoline inventories rose 800,000 barrels last week to 207.7 million barrels, according to the EIA. Stocks are 5% below the five-year average for this time of year. Tight, certainly, but hardly empty-tankish. Refineries processed 17.3 million barrels per day last week and operated at 96.8% utilization. Gasoline production increased to 9.6 million bpd.
